$comment: Flag-only variant of api_explorer_petstore.json. Activates the toolkit via enabled_tools: ["api_explorer"] WITHOUT a tool_configurations entry. Demonstrates the simplified frontend UX added on 2026-05-19 (commits 131c540 + 3f1a9f3 + dd47a54).

config.default: Using the Petstore OpenAPI 3.0 spec at https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/openapi.json, build a request to add a new pet named 'Rex' (id 42, status 'available'). Return only the final http_request JSON config you would execute.

config.system_message: You are an integration agent. Use api_explorer__load_spec to load an OpenAPI URL, api_explorer__search_endpoint to find what you need, api_explorer__get_endpoint_details to check argument shapes, and api_explorer__build_http_request (which requires a `params` object mapping each parameter name to its value, and merges request-body fields into that same object) to construct a valid call. Never guess parameter names — always call api_explorer__get_endpoint_details first.
